A masked person stands directly in front of the camera wearer, facing them and holding a phone within arm’s reach, partially blocking the forward path. Several other people are nearby—roughly one to three meters away—including individuals in matching outfits who appear to be cast or team members; some face toward the wearer while others bend down or move around behind them. The setting resembles a backstage or changing area rather than a kitchen or pool. Given the apparent post-performance gathering, the most socially appropriate action is to congratulate the cast members.
